effect: The last result completed the fat goal and clarified that bile spreads droplets while enzymes break fat molecules apart.

mostWorthwhile.text: Spreading fat with bile and then using enzymes was most worthwhile because it showed two different jobs, not just two ways of breaking fat down.

leastWorthwhile.text: Breaking down protein was clear but felt predictable after seeing starch become smaller units.

surprise.text: The smaller fat droplets exposed more surface, even though bile hadn't broken the fat molecules apart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final enzyme pairing was the only offered action rather than a discovery.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following food from larger molecules to smaller ones was clear, and I'd be curious to see what happens after digestion.
